comment: With !verbose, the Tourist puts her towel on as a blindfold and removes it, then tries to take off her shirt, from the inventory menu. invent.c ddoinv() calls dispinv_with_action(), which hands the picked item to iactions.c itemactions(), whose itemactions_pushkeys() queues the command and the item letter, and invent.c getobj() takes the letter from cmdq_pop() without a prompt.
